theorems.name: Submission.dpfir_bilipschitz_image_imrep_exists
theorems.statement: ∀ (P n : ℕ) (U : Set (Euclid P)) (R : IMRep U n) (φ : Euclid P → Euclid P) (Λ : NNReal) (η : Euclid P → MultiVector P n), Bijective φ → LipschitzWith Λ φ → AntilipschitzWith Λ φ → φ ⁻¹' U = U → AEStronglyMeasurable η (μHE[n].restrict R.carrier) → (∀ᵐ x ∂(μHE[n].restrict R.carrier), ∃ Q : Submodule ℝ (Euclid P), HasApproximateTangentSpaceAt n (φ '' R.carrier) (φ x) Q ∧ IsUnitOrientationOf (η x) Q) → ∃ R' : IMRep U n, R'.carrier = φ '' R.carrier ∧ ∀ x, R'.mult (φ x) = R.mult x ∧ R'.orient (φ x) = η x
